dailyDefinition.relativeStrengthShort: 50% 1D + 50% 5D benchmark-relative return, then percentile-ranked across rank-eligible themes
dailyDefinition.participation: share of members with positive 1D return and RVOL >= 1.0
dailyDefinition.concentrationQuality: normalized inverse HHI of positive 5D benchmark-relative returns; single-winner themes score 0

note: Daily v1.0 fixed rule: short benchmark-relative strength 35 / breadth 30 / volume participation 15 / leader 15 / concentration quality 5. Weekly and Leader logic unchanged from 3.0.0-observed-technicals. Historical snapshots are never recomputed. US short benchmark uses S&P 500; Japan short benchmark prefers TOPIX with Nikkei 225 fallback when TOPIX is unavailable. No validation of investment effectiveness.
